SELECT COUNT(ch.*) from cm_hospital ch
ch.is_enabled
AND (ch.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchText}, '%') OR ch.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchText}, '%'))

select ch.seq, ch.name, ch.address, ch.corp_number, ch.homepage, ch.prof_name, ch.prof_email, ch.prof_major, ch.prof_phone, to_char(cast(ch.created_at at time zone 'kst' AS timestamp), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as createdAt from cm_hospital ch
ch.is_enabled
AND (ch.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchText}, '%') OR ch.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchText}, '%'))
ORDER BY ch.seq DESC
LIMIT #{pagination.endNum} OFFSET #{pagination.startNum}

SELECT COUNT(ch.*) from cm_hospital ch
ch.is_enabled

select ch.seq, ch.name, ch.address, ch.corp_number, ch.homepage, ch.prof_name, ch.prof_email, ch.prof_major, ch.prof_phone, to_char(cast(ch.created_at at time zone 'kst' AS timestamp), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as createdAt from cm_hospital ch
ch.is_enabled
ORDER BY ch.seq DESC
LIMIT #{pagination.endNum} OFFSET #{pagination.startNum}

select ch.seq, ch.name, ch.address, ch.corp_number, ch.homepage, ch.prof_name, ch.prof_email, ch.prof_major, ch.prof_phone, to_char(cast(ch.created_at at time zone 'kst' AS timestamp), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as createdAt from cm_hospital ch
ch.is_enabled AND ch.seq = #{seq}

SELECT hs.hospital_seq, ch.name as hospitalName from hospital_service hs left join cm_hospital ch on ch.seq = hs.hospital_seq
hs.account_seq = #{acSeq} AND hs.is_enabled
group by hs.hospital_seq, ch.name

SELECT hd.seq, hd.disease_seq, cd.name as diseaseName from hp_disease hd join cm_disease cd on cd.seq = hd.disease_seq and cd.is_enabled
hd.hospital_seq = #{hSeq} AND hd.is_enabled
AND hd.disease_seq != 8
order by hd.seq

SELECT op.seq, op.group_name, op.option_name from hp_disease_option op
op.hp_disease_seq = #{seq} AND op.is_enabled
order by op.sort

SELECT mm.seq, mm.name, mm.treatment_period from hp_disease_treatment mm
mm.hp_disease_seq = #{seq} AND mm.is_enabled
order by mm.sort
